quarterly_data.quarter: Skyverse Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue rose 34.01% YoY, which the company attributes to new products such as darkfield nano-pattern wafer defect inspection, upgraded series such as 4th-gen unpatterned wafer defect inspection and 3rd-gen overlay metrology, and a growing revenue contribution from HBM and 2.5D/3D advanced packaging. It reported a net loss attributable to shareholders as R&D, marketing and headcount grew; gross margin fell on product sales mix and initial pricing of new products. R&D spending rose 33.55% to 40.51% of revenue.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue RMB 941,017,703.76 (H1 2025 RMB 702,173,929.99, +34.01%); net profit attributable to shareholders RMB -127,437,687.34; R&D RMB 381,177,813.55 (+33.55%, 40.51% of revenue)

quarterly_data.quarter: Skyverse Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: HBM and advanced packaging: its 3D AOI patterned wafer defect inspection tool for HBM and other advanced packaging passed validation at a leading domestic customer, and its patterned inspection and 3D topography metrology tools passed line validation at multiple overseas advanced-packaging customers and are in volume sales. Its wafer flatness metrology tool has shipped to a leading domestic HBM customer for process development and validation (a higher-precision 2nd-gen is expected to ship soon to a leading domestic memory customer). Its X-ray high-aspect-ratio etch-structure metrology and TSV copper-fill void metrology tools are in use on leading domestic memory customers' lines; the TSV tool is being sample-tested by multiple leading domestic 2.5D/3D advanced-packaging customers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Skyverse Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Front-end tool progress: 3rd- and 4th-gen unpatterned wafer defect inspection tools passed validation at multiple leading domestic logic and memory customers; the series sold to an overseas advanced-packaging customer and shipped to an overseas advanced-process customer for line validation. Darkfield nano-pattern wafer defect inspection passed line validation at multiple leading domestic logic, memory and advanced-packaging customers and is in volume sales; its most advanced version is in sample validation. Brightfield nano-pattern inspection for mature nodes is in volume sales and the advanced-node version has received some customer orders. The 4th-gen overlay metrology tool for the most advanced domestic processes has shipped to multiple leading domestic customers for line validation; the 2nd-gen optical CD tool shipped in small batches; the e-beam CD metrology prototype is in customer sample validation.
